title: GitHub Actions browser verification evidence - 9 October 2026

provenance.note: Summary extracted from the actual GitHub Actions browser-report artifact. CI build fingerprints were not recorded; local served-artifact hashes are not asserted for this Linux build.

outcomeDefinitions.expected: Attempt matched expectedStatus; these runs contain passed attempts.

coverageLimits: The complete suite executed all five configured browser projects on the GitHub Actions Linux runner.
Mobile projects use browser emulation. No physical phone or manual screen-reader pass is claimed.
Five live GitHub smoke checks are intentionally skipped unless explicitly enabled. Mocked API and persistence workflows ran.
Real clipboard permission grants are Chromium-specific; the Firefox and two WebKit clipboard-write checks are intentionally skipped. Clipboard interaction is separately tested in every engine.
